latest_release.name: v3.93.0
latest_release.body:
## [v3.93.0](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/compare/v3.92.1...v3.93.0) (2026-11-04)

⚠️ Contains vital security updates. We encourage updating as soon as possible.

### 🚀 Features

* add auth.passwordHashIterations for environments that limit PBKDF2 (3.x) ([#19074](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/19074)) ([488f183](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/488f183))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* enforce block child read access in queries ([21bdbbf](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/21bdbbf))
* restrict blocks to each field's configured types ([cfa60ea](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/cfa60ea))
* enforce pasteURL restrictions on remote URL uploads ([9071e58](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/9071e58))
* apply xml response policy to xsl content ([50d25f2](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/50d25f2))
* constrain global view redirects to available tenants ([63a3a69](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/63a3a69))
* preserve shared localized draft changes (3.x backport of #17367) ([#17394](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/17394)) ([49b3c0b](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/49b3c0b))
* resolve config labels before interpolating them into strings ([#19209](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/19209)) ([9c37160](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/9c37160))
* prevent error in sendEmail due to empty from recepient ([#18189](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/18189)) ([aaea87b](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/aaea87b))
* delete the browser upload when a processed client upload replaces it for upload-thing storage ([#19012](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/19012)) ([8995c00](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/8995c00))
* **drizzle:** lazily load drizzle kit tooling (3.x) ([#17660](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/17660)) ([d89c7c8](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/d89c7c8))
* **next:** clamp description param on og endpoint ([a56cc64](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/a56cc64))
* **richtext-lexical:** escape stored values in HTML converters ([bed603f](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/bed603f))
* **ui:** translate document drawer labels (3.x) ([#19154](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/19154)) ([b4e131c](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/b4e131c))
* **ui:** prevent duplicate autosaves from virtual field updates ([#19096](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/19096)) ([ef1bb73](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/ef1bb73))
* **ui:** translate the collection label in the create new card button (3.x) ([#19116](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/19116)) ([04ec212](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/04ec212))

### ⚙️ CI

* skip content api tests for audit deps PRs (3.x) ([#19300](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/19300)) ([59c52a7](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/59c52a7))
* port audit-dependencies action to 3.x ([#19118](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/19118)) ([8bbd52e](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/commit/8bbd52e))
